confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live menus or booking pages. Restaurant, coffee and drink anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation is less certain: Delft has limited hostel and hotel supply and July demand is high, so the hostel and hotel anchors are wider bounded estimates. Drink anchors are direct estimates, not derived from beer. The FX value was taken from a search excerpt of the RBA exchange-rates page and was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized Dutch heritage and university cities with strong tourism and Randstad price levels, such as Leiden, Haarlem and Utrecht, adjusted for Delft's proximity to The Hague, Rotterdam and Amsterdam, which tends to push summer accommodation prices up.
